title: GitHub is storage only: release records in git, installers and release sync build tags from source, gate tool posts no commit statuses
goal: CEO mandate 2026-11-09 00:15 (GitHub is storage only) and decision 00:22 (binaries are built from git tags; no artifact store). A release is a tag plus its committed record releases/<tag>.json (schema susi-release-record/v1: commit, build toolchain/profile/features/env/command, reference-build sha256 per asset, missing targets, checks), documented in docs/releases.md, with the v0.21.52 record from facts. install.sh, install.ps1 and scripts/susi-release-sync.sh resolve the newest tag with git ls-remote --tags against a configured remote, check it out, build it natively with the recorded settings under the rust-toolchain.toml pin, and install only a binary that reports the tag's version; no download, no gh, no hard-coded host, no auto-installed software. The gate tool stops posting commit statuses and drops its GitHub ruleset and Actions commands; GitHub-only scripts are deleted with their references; a guard test refuses new GitHub couplings.
